reason: Both meet all hard requirements, but Response B is more technically precise and actionable: it separates WAL/temp volume monitoring from main disk, offers a concrete fix if snapshot capacity itself is constrained (snapshot to a separate target), adds a non-destructive write-throttling option to buy time, and its abort/rollback condition specifies concrete reversal steps plus post-mitigation data integrity checks (checksums, replica consistency) that Response A omits.
